title: Guided reading: Mark 4:39
subtitle: Read aorist command and narrative response.
overview: This short narrative lets you separate an aorist participle, direct speech, and the events that follow.
Read the aorists as the story’s key events; do not impose a simplistic rule that every aorist means a single instant.

sections.title: Mark 4:39 pieces
rows: a great calm came to be

items.grc: καὶ διεγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τῷ ἀνέμῳ καὶ εἶπεν τῇ θαλάσσῃ· σιώπα, πεφίμωσο.
items.en: And having been awakened, he rebuked the wind and said to the sea, “Be silent; be muzzled.”

items.grc: καὶ ἐκόπασεν ὁ ἄνεμος καὶ ἐγένετο γαλήνη μεγάλη.
items.en: And the wind ceased, and a great calm came to be.
